claim_label: Feasibility of Rapid AI Oversight Implementation
description: The conflict centers on whether existing statutory authority is sufficient to establish robust AI oversight within an 18-month timeframe or if a more extensive, long-term regulatory framework is required to ensure safety.

instances.assertion: Existing FTC Section 5 authority allows for the implementation of pre-deployment auditing and strict liability within 18 months.
18 months is insufficient to build the necessary institutional guardrails; a more comprehensive, long-term framework is required to prevent systemic collapse.
